[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 360
- Description: QR-asset architectural cleanup + provenance surface. Created TrueSightDAO/lineage-assets repo (public): parallel architecture to lineage-credentials, applied to physical assets. Seeded 1457 per-QR JSON manifests from the Agroverse QR codes sheet. Built truesight.me/qr/?id=<qr_id> renderer page (full site templating, mobile-responsive, graceful PNG-missing handling, Related section linking to shipment+lab-report + farm profile with explicit farm-slug map). Executed Option B consolidation: migrated 729 PNGs from qr_codes repo into lineage-assets/pngs/; moved QR generator from tokenomics/python_scripts/agroverse_qr_code_generator/ into lineage-assets/scripts/qr_generator/ (tokenomics path now deprecation breadcrumb); extracted shared scripts/lib/manifest.py module so the seed importer and per-mint generator produce identical JSON shape regardless of entry point; batch_compiler.py now writes three artifacts per mint (compiled label image + raw PNG + per-QR manifest) with new CLI flags. Replaced truesight.me/physical-assets/serialized Product Verification page (was a hard-redirect to the raw Google Sheet) with a searchable filterable listing fetched from new qrs_index.json. Archived qr_codes repo. Production QR-scan UX intentionally unchanged (Edgar landing_page redirect untouched until Kirsten + operator review and step-function switch). Seven PRs merged: agentic_ai_context 167 and 169, truesight_me_beta 129 130 132 133, tokenomics 299, plus direct push to new lineage-assets repo. Truesight prod synced via Contents API on all four changes (CNAME verified intact each time per the documented gh repo sync force footgun rule). New canonical doc at agentic_ai_context/LINEAGE_ASSETS.md captures the architecture, repo layout, schema, generator integration, listing page, and what is deliberately not in v0.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
--------
